sources.snippet: ACT_sim_handle_basket (RoboSynChallenge submission checkpoint) ACT (Action Chunking with Transformers) checkpoint for the RoboSynChallenge handle_basket simulation task, re-packaged in the LeRobot 0.4.4 layout so that it loads without any legacy code path. This checkpoint is the imitation-learning component of our preliminary-round submission.
